purpose: Provide a machine-readable, fail-closed evidence gate for ThreadKeeper C2 Implemented maturity.

gateRequirements.title: Accepted TK-001 capability contract
gateRequirements.nextAction: Retain TK-001 as the controlling capability contract.

gateRequirements.title: Accepted TK-002 implementation design
gateRequirements.nextAction: Retain TK-002 as the controlling C2 implementation and evidence design.

gateRequirements.title: Exact final C2 implementation commit
gateRequirements.limitations: TK-003 and TK-004 provide accepted implementation slices, but the final C2 commit cannot be bound until TK-005 evidence-completion changes are frozen.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Bind the exact final implementation SHA only after TK-005 code and evidence are complete.

gateRequirements.title: Isolated migration and schema evidence
gateRequirements.nextAction: Retain TK-004 persistence verification as a C2 prerequisite.

gateRequirements.title: Unit-test evidence
gateRequirements.nextAction: Extend rather than replace the accepted core regression suite when closing remaining C2 gaps.

gateRequirements.title: Isolated PostgreSQL integration evidence
gateRequirements.nextAction: Retain the disposable PostgreSQL 17 proof as the persistence integration gate.

gateRequirements.title: Required failure-injection evidence
gateRequirements.limitations: Digest tamper, ambiguous identity, conflicting evidence, stale-head concurrency, illegal transition, and idempotency conflicts are proven. Evidence timeout, missing provenance, stale authority, dependency outage, route cycle, storage failure, and false-positive dismissal remain incomplete.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Add only the missing failure fixtures and preserve fail-closed or explicit unresolved behavior.

gateRequirements.title: ACP regression preservation
gateRequirements.nextAction: Rerun ACP regression if TK-005 changes shared continuity primitives.

gateRequirements.title: Security and privacy boundary review
gateRequirements.limitations: Secret rejection, RLS, least privilege, immutability, and external acceptance authority are proven. Explicit reference-over-copy and sensitive log/metric canary proofs are still required.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Add focused canary and reference-only tests without broadening data access.

gateRequirements.title: Authority-boundary tests
gateRequirements.nextAction: Retain self-approval prohibition, external validation, and stale-head enforcement as regression invariants.

gateRequirements.title: Adjacent-system non-absorption proof
gateRequirements.limitations: The ownership boundaries are canonical in contract and design, but C2 still requires executable boundary-adapter tests proving references and routes do not invoke or absorb neighboring systems.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Add injected fake/read-only boundary resolvers and no-execution assertions.

gateRequirements.title: Vendor-neutral observability baseline
gateRequirements.limitations: No ThreadKeeper observability adapter currently exists under server/src/threadkeeper.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Implement bounded counters and latency observations with no sensitive evidence payloads and no vendor lock-in.

gateRequirements.title: Canonical Development Evidence records
gateRequirements.limitations: TK-004 persistence acceptance is canonical. TK-005 completion and final C2 evidence have not yet been recorded.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Write TK-005 evidence through CDE as it is produced and append final promotion only after all gates pass.

gateRequirements.title: Governed projection reconciliation
gateRequirements.limitations: C1 projections are reconciled. A successful C2 promotion changes the governed maturity claim and therefore requires the relevant CCI/MLC/DPE/EDG projection update and verification.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Reconcile only after C2 evidence is otherwise complete, then rerun MCTRL.

gateRequirements.title: Post-change MCTRL PASS
gateRequirements.limitations: TK-004 post-merge MCTRL passed 18/18, but TK-005 requires a new post-change MCTRL result on the final C2 evidence head.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Run MCTRL after all TK-005 code, evidence, and projection changes are frozen.

gateRequirements.title: Explicit governed C2 maturity promotion journal
gateRequirements.limitations: Promotion is intentionally absent while any required evidence remains partial or missing.
gateRequirements.nextAction: Append the C2 promotion journal only after the matrix is fully satisfied and post-change MCTRL passes.

testRequirements.title: Canonical checkpoint digest is deterministic
testRequirements.limitations: Integrity is checked, but the ThreadKeeper test does not yet explicitly compare equivalent proposals for identical digest output.
testRequirements.nextAction: Add exact deterministic digest equivalence assertion.

testRequirements.title: Stale or invalid authority fails
testRequirements.limitations: Self-authority and stale accepted head are covered; a dedicated stale external authority fixture remains required.
testRequirements.nextAction: Add stale external authority validation fixture.

testRequirements.title: Missing required evidence cannot return INTACT
Route policy is deterministic and versioned
testRequirements.limitations: Route codes are exercised, but policy-version preservation needs an explicit assertion.

testRequirements.title: Lineage traversal detects cycles or broken links
testRequirements.limitations: Broken predecessor classification and valid lineage traversal are covered; explicit corrupted-cycle/broken-link traversal injection remains absent.

testRequirements.title: Context projection returns references rather than duplicated payloads
testRequirements.limitations: Context projection is exercised, but raw-payload exclusion is not asserted explicitly.

testRequirements.title: Assessment immutability
testRequirements.limitations: The shared immutability trigger covers assessments, but a direct negative integration assertion is still desirable.
testRequirements.nextAction: Add UPDATE/DELETE rejection assertion for assessment.

testRequirements.title: Case transition append-only behavior
testRequirements.limitations: Illegal terminal transition is rejected, but direct UPDATE/DELETE rejection is not asserted in the integration test.

testRequirements.title: Parent checkpoint foreign-key integrity
testRequirements.limitations: Constraint exists, but explicit negative integration evidence is not yet mapped.

testRequirements.title: Idempotent duplicate observation handling
testRequirements.limitations: Assessment idempotency is proven, but observation receipt/idempotency is not yet represented as an explicit ThreadKeeper service contract.
testRequirements.nextAction: Implement bounded observation receipt semantics without adding a competing raw event store.

testRequirements.title: Conflicting duplicate observation rejection
testRequirements.limitations: Conflicting assessment idempotency is proven, but duplicate observation identity conflict is not explicit.
testRequirements.nextAction: Add service-level conflicting observation receipt rejection.

testRequirements.title: Restart persistence roundtrip
testRequirements.nextAction: Add isolated database reconnect/restart-style readback proof without introducing new persistence state.

testRequirements.title: No forbidden schema or privilege exposure
Conversation History reference resolves without raw transcript copy
testRequirements.nextAction: Add injected read-only reference resolver and raw-content canary exclusion assertion.

testRequirements.title: Foundry outcome remains authoritative outside ThreadKeeper
testRequirements.nextAction: Add fake/read-only Foundry resolver proving ThreadKeeper consumes evidence without writing execution state.

testRequirements.title: Unavailable evidence resolver remains unresolved or degraded
testRequirements.nextAction: Add resolver timeout/unavailable fixture and fail-closed result.

testRequirements.title: Helper Matrix route is emitted without helper execution
testRequirements.nextAction: Add no-call fake adapter assertion around REQUEST_HELPER_ANALYSIS.

testRequirements.title: SEAL route is emitted without revision execution
testRequirements.nextAction: Add no-call fake adapter assertion around REQUEST_SEAL_REVIEW.

testRequirements.title: Expired checkpoint handling where expiry policy applies
testRequirements.rationale: TK-002 defaults accepted semantic checkpoints to no global expiry. ACP expiry remains a separate continuity substrate behavior and is not silently imported into ThreadKeeper semantic scope validity.
testRequirements.nextAction: Reopen only if a future scope-specific expiry policy is approved.

testRequirements.title: Missing required provenance fails closed
testRequirements.nextAction: Add missing-provenance fixture distinct from generic missing-evidence behavior.

testRequirements.title: Stale external authority fails closed
testRequirements.nextAction: Add explicit stale/revoked external authority fixture.

testRequirements.title: Evidence source timeout remains unresolved
testRequirements.nextAction: Add injected resolver timeout and verify no fabricated continuity result.

testRequirements.title: Dependency outage cannot produce false completion
Repeated route cycle escalates without looping
testRequirements.nextAction: Add bounded route-cycle detection and human/governance escalation fixture.

testRequirements.title: Concurrent checkpoint acceptance produces one winner
Storage write failure is explicit and does not invent persistence
testRequirements.nextAction: Inject repository write failure and assert explicit failure with no accepted result.

testRequirements.title: False-positive break dismissal preserves original assessment evidence
testRequirements.nextAction: Add append-only dismissal/resolution fixture proving the original assessment remains immutable.
